meaning: A small picture file that plays a short, silent clip over and over. People send it in chats to show a feeling.
clues: It is a kind of picture file.
The picture moves, but it makes no sound.
It plays the same few seconds again and again, in a loop.
People send one in a chat to react, like a clapping hand or a shrugging cat.
It has three letters, all capitals, and starts with G.
assumes: A JPEG is a photo file that does not move
A PDF is a document file
An MP3 is a music file

decoys.meaning: A common file type for photos. It squeezes a picture so the file is smaller.
A file type for documents. It looks the same on any screen or printer.
A file type for music. It squeezes sound so a song takes less space.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: I am a file too, but I only held a few pages. A little cat dancing forever in a tiny file? Amazing.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Tip: many phone keyboards have a GIF button. Tap it, search for a mood, and send one.
